description: Credit closed-end fund discount reversion. Long funds trading unusually cheap against their OWN discount history, short those unusually rich, dollar-neutral, 5-day rebalance, volatility-targeted to 6% annualised. Since v8 the account holds sizing_multiplier x that 6%-target book (CEF trial 53). A CEF has a fixed share count and no authorised participants, so nothing arbitrages price back to NAV -- which is precisely why this works here and died in ETFs, where the AP mechanism compressed the same gap from 188bp (2008) to 3.8bp (2026).

frozen._z_window_note: REVERTED to 252 on 2026-07-31 after the sealed holdout FAILED the change. Original rationale follows, and it was wrong out-of-sample: chosen 252 -> 63 on 2026-07-31, chosen on 2005-2023 with the 2024-01+ holdout untouched (results/cef/ESTIMATOR_NOTE.md). A 252-day boxcar weights an eleven-month-old discount as heavily as yesterday's and lags by about half its window. Per-name costs, hold=2, shift=2, pre-holdout net Sharpe: 21d 0.37, 63d 0.84, 126d 0.65, 252d 0.69. 63d is an INTERIOR optimum, not a boundary. A full Kalman state-space model (theta random walk + AR(1) dislocation, phi=0.9722 measured) was built and REJECTED: net 0.81, beaten by this one-line change despite fixing the post-cut misreading the rolling window suffers.
frozen._rebalance_days_note: INERT while band_width is set -- a band and a calendar are two answers to the same question and running both compounds them. Retained so deleting band_width restores v5 exactly.
frozen._order_type_note: Market-on-close. The signal needs the fund's NAV, which only exists after the close, so the decision is necessarily made in the evening. A plain market order rests overnight and fills at the next open; on 2026-07-31 that produced fills at 07:27 ET -- two hours before the exchange opened -- at up to 2.9% from the decision price against a ~0.1% modelled cost. MOC executes in the next closing auction, which is both the deepest liquidity of the day and the execution point the backtest assumed.
frozen._band_width_note: NO-TRADE BAND, activated 2026-09-06. Replaces the rebalance_days calendar: the signal is recomputed every session and a position is left alone unless it is more than 4.8% (in weight) from target, then traded back to the BAND EDGE, not to target. Constantinides (1986), Davis & Norman (1990). DERIVED, NOT OPTIMISED: the cube-root law h* = (3c.sigma_w^2/2.kappa_w)^(1/3) on measured target-weight dynamics (sigma_w=0.04083/day, phi_w=0.95280 => kappa_w=0.04835, half-life 14.3d) gives 4.26% at 15bp and 4.85% at 22bp; the cube-root scaling verifies exactly (h(30bp)/h(15bp)=1.260 vs 2^(1/3)=1.2599). 4.8% is the derived width at a mid-range cost estimate AND the lower edge of the measured plateau (4.8-9.6%). 6.4% topped the swept column and was NOT chosen -- selecting the argmax of a sweep is how z_window=63 was picked, and it failed out of sample. Measured full sample: gross 1.16, turnover 17.6x/yr (vs 31.1 on the calendar), net@15bp 0.66 (vs 0.33), and net@30bp +0.17 where EVERY calendar configuration goes negative. See docs/PLAN.md Part 2 and results/cef/PREREG_BAND_2026-09-06.md. REVERT: delete this key; rebalance_days resumes and behaviour is byte-identical to v5.

frozen._max_gross_stress_note: HARD CEILING ON GROSS EXPOSURE AS A MULTIPLE OF SLEEVE NAV, activated 2026-09-28 (v7-on-Alpaca). UNITS: a MULTIPLE, not a percent and not dollars, applied to gross = sum|w| of the HELD book AFTER the band, by one uniform multiplier f = cap/gross in (0,1); it only ever scales DOWN and never flattens. NOT the same object as risk.max_gross_exposure_usd. DERIVED, NOT CHOSEN, by the rule pre-registered in results/cef/PREREG_GROUP_CAP_2026-09-16.md section 3b: G_stress = (NLV - M_other)/(m + w5)/E_book, floored to 0.05 after subtracting the mark sensitivity. Alpaca inputs: NLV $100,000 (probe 2026-09-28), M_other $0 (one book per account), m = 0.50 Reg T initial margin (team lead 2026-09-28; Alpaca's maintenance on these names is 0.30), E_book $100,000, w5 = 0.0425814 = worst 5-session total-return loss per unit gross held of the 13-name band, ending 2020-03-18 (method reproduces the recorded 17-name 0.038264817497540925 to 1e-12). G_stress = 1.843041; no mark sensitivity (no other books) -> floor_0.05 = 1.80. NOT CHOSEN: 1.843 itself (no room for its own movement) and no cap (the 13-name band reaches 2.77x and exceeds 1.80x on 13.2% of traded days). Plateau flat: gross SR 1.141-1.174 across caps 1.60 to none. CEF trial 50. KNOWN STALENESS: G_stress moves with NLV and Alpaca's margin rules; re-derive by this rule at a promotion, never re-tune on P&L. READ BY src/deploy/sleeves/cef_discount.py (_max_gross_stress, _cap_gross) and scripts/cef/spec.py (MAX_GROSS_STRESS). Reproducer: python3 scripts/cef/alpaca_v7_derivation.py. frozen._sizing_multiplier_note: ACCOUNT SIZING MULTIPLIER, CEF trial 53, AMENDMENT 1 (approved by the team lead 2026-11-02; results/cef/PREREG_VOLTARGET_2026-10-30.md section 0.B; activated at 1.13 on 2026-11-01, spec v8). UNITS: a MULTIPLE of the UNIT book (the book this spec builds at vol_target_annual 0.06, exactly as v7), not a percent and not a vol; while the book trades, the account's effective ex-ante vol target is 0.06 x 1.30 = 7.8% on the unit book's 6% scale (its realised unit vol while trading is 5.65%, so about 7.3%). WHY AMENDED: v8's 1.13 was derived on the canonical harness's book, which HOLDS the previous target on a thin session (fewer than min_names eligible); this sleeve FLATTENS there (target_positions, the min_names block). Under the live rule the core is flat on 1,353 of W1's 2,398 sessions (results/backtests/thin-days-2026-11-03/REPORT.md section 6; results/cef/prereg_voltarget/FLATTEN_REMEASURE_2026-11-02.md). DERIVED, NOT CHOSEN: the 2026-10-29 declared rule as before (equal standalone risk per account, b = 1/2, 1/2, C4's term (d) binding at 5.25%), whose multipliers satisfy m_core / m_c4 = sd_c4 / sd_core exactly, with sd_core the core unit book's daily sd on the sessions it TRADES (a book held two sessions earlier) on the flatten book, 0.003556 (5.65%/yr), and sd_c4 0.003659: 1.2642 x 0.003659 / 0.003556 = 1.3007, written to 2 dp ROUNDED DOWN: 1.30 (flatten_remeasure.py; flatten_series.py builds the flatten book with research-thin-days' harness option, c7a1635). NOT CHOSEN: 1.13 (v8: the hold book's sd 0.004095; under the live rule it carries less risk than the trial approved, zero-edge P(HALVE)/P(KILL) 10.3% / 0.66% while trading); and 1.96, the same rule fed the flatten book's CALENDAR sd 0.002351, which is inflated because the flat sessions count as zero risk: while trading it would size the core for about 1.3 times C4's realised risk. Plateau: with C4 at 1.26 the combined Sharpe is 1.624-1.638 for every core multiplier from 0.8 to 2.5; 1.30 is at 1.626 (live_pair_grid_2026-11-02_flatten_m1.30.csv). CONSEQUENCE accepted knowingly (fit only, the flatten book, W1 2013-06-25..2022-12-30; flatten_exact_2026-11-02, flatten_remeasure_2026-11-02_m1.30): exact-build gross 3.78%/yr total return over the calendar and 8.67%/yr while trading (SR 1.222), against 3.31 / 7.59 at 1.13; held at the cap on 15.2% of the sessions with a book (6.5% at 1.13); max drawdown 8.39% (7.53% at 1.13); zero-edge P(HALVE in 12 months) 16.7%, P(KILL) 1.68% while trading, about the 15.9% / 1.5% the trial approved; through 2008, on trading sessions over the 5 non-thin year-end books, P(HALVE) 5.1 / 15.1 / 47.1% and P(KILL) 0.18 / 1.78 / 14.4% (min/median/max; a fixed-book upper bound). THE STOPS (pre-registration section 0.B): R1 10.14%, R2 -3.06%, R3 12.07%, calibrated on the flatten book's trading sessions, re-measured on the read date by results/cef/prereg_voltarget/stops.py --core-earning-only, read and acted on by the team lead; nothing in code reads them. It is an amendment, not a new trial: CEF stays 53. WHAT: the account holds m x the unit book. The band compares the unit target with held/m; _cap_gross acts at max_gross_stress/m in unit weights (= max_gross_stress x NAV, the object gate 8 and fit_to_buying_power enforce); weight targets are emitted as m x the unit weight; band HOLDs stay in shares and the dust filter reads the unit weight. vol_target_annual is NOT moved, so every research reader of spec.VOL_TARGET stays on the unit book. V8, SUPERSEDED, kept as the record: the team lead's objective (2026-10-29/30: the percentage return on ALL capital; the core 13 and C4 in two $100k accounts at equal standalone risk) under the 2026-10-29 rule's per-account margin term (d) on W1, combined target 5.25%, per-account multiplier = 2 x s b_k / (sd_k sd_c) with the HOLD book's sd 0.004095 -> core 1.1357 -> 1.13 (results/cef/prereg_voltarget/derive.py section 4). The draft's 1.24 (the 2026-10-28 rule, 5.75%) was not chosen then either, nor was raising vol_target_annual, which narrows the band relative to the book and moves every research reader of the key. The framework's gate on a vol increase is waived for paper only (team lead 2026-11-01, docs/SYSTEM.md section 5). The stops are read on Alpaca's end-of-day history, and no acting mode is built. rebalance._min_trade_note: RE-DERIVED 2026-09-28 for Alpaca: $0. The v6 value ($517) solved $F + N*hs/1e4 = N*30/1e4 for N with F = $1, IBKR's minimum commission per order. Alpaca charges NO commission per order (fee schedule fetched 2026-09-28); its SEC/TAF/CAT fees are proportional to the order, not fixed. With F = 0 the same equation gives N = 0. Team lead, 2026-09-28: follow the formula. The only floor is ONE WHOLE SHARE -- Alpaca will not short or route to the closing auction a fractional order. Paper is scored gross (D19/D20), so a small order costs nothing scored. READ BY scripts/cef/spec.py (MIN_TRADE_USD); the Alpaca runner must read it. REVERT: 517.0 with the v6 note (git show spec-cef_discount.v6.20260906:ops/specs/cef_discount.frozen.json).

kill_rule: Review at 60 live sessions, not before. KILL if any of: (a) live net Sharpe < 0.0; (b) realised slippage > 2x modelled for 5 consecutive sessions; (c) cross-sectional top-minus-bottom discount spread falls below 12% (half its current 22.5%), which would mean the opportunity has gone the way of E1. No extension of rope.
